question: Should automatic tool-progress intent become a supported shared reply/Plugin SDK contract, or must this fix remain entirely Slack-local without Codex-to-Slack private metadata?
rationale: The current implementation requires a durable cross-plugin intent boundary, and choosing that public or private ownership model affects Plugin SDK compatibility and future channel behavior.

options.title: Add typed shared intent
options.body: Introduce a generic typed progress intent, migrate Codex and Slack together, and preserve every documented Slack delivery mode.

options.title: Keep detection Slack-local
options.body: Remove Codex-authored metadata and solve suppression entirely within Slack using channel-owned inputs without a hidden cross-plugin contract.

options.title: Pause this approach
options.body: Do not merge until the progress-draft owner decides whether the underlying leak should instead be fixed earlier in the existing streaming pipeline.

recommendation.title: Add typed shared intent
recommendation.body: Introduce a generic typed progress intent, migrate Codex and Slack together, and preserve every documented Slack delivery mode.

likelyOwner.reason: The relevant shared progress-draft configuration and Slack progress rendering history most strongly point to this owner for the contract decision.
